note: Wazuh disk space incident (Apr 1 2026): Indexer threw "No space left on device" errors but was already recovered when investigated. Main space consumers: /var/ossec/queue/vd/feed (8.3G vulnerability detector RocksDB), /var/ossec/logs/alerts (2.6G), /var/lib/wazuh-indexer (7.6G). Indexer API requires cert auth: curl -k --cacert /etc/wazuh-indexer/certs/root-ca.pem --cert /etc/wazuh-indexer/certs/admin.pem --key /etc/wazuh-indexer/certs/admin-key.pem https://localhost:9200/_cluster/health

Wazuh ISM policy `wazuh-retention` created: 90-day auto-delete for `wazuh-alerts-*` indices. Applied to 47 existing indices via POST to _plugins/_ism/add/wazuh-alerts-*. New indices auto-apply via ism_template. Single-node cluster shows yellow due to unassigned replica on .opendistro-ism-config (expected, not a problem).
